interpretation: The published successive-approximation stopping rule was preserved exactly and was not relaxed after execution.
A small difference between consecutive fixed-point iterates does not by itself bound distance to the Green-Ampt root when the local contraction factor is close to one.
The paper does not specify enough initialization detail to convert the historical method into a seed-independent SWAP5 numerical contract.
This result does not prove the M2WC70 implementation is wrong because the official C code may use a specific initialization policy not yet inspected.
All frozen K/psi/delta-theta groups showed strict dependence of the exact root on dt; timestep provenance is therefore required for any cached dry-bin advance.
